description: Mumbler: a clawed child-sized creature, the PAL stand-in for the Grey Child. On the US disc it lurks in the Resort Area around Annie's Bar and in the sewer to the Lakeside Amusement Park.

_param_units.collision_ground_walker: 1: the wall / ledge / void classification applies (walks on the ground)

spawn.note: state 17 is the dead body of the Stalker family
